# Wayang AI - AI Agent Workflow Platform

Wayang AI is a powerful, open-source platform for building and deploying AI agent workflows. It provides a visual designer, a robust execution engine, and a comprehensive ecosystem for AI-driven automation.

## Features

- **Visual Workflow Designer**: Drag-and-drop interface for building complex agent workflows
- **AI-Powered Automation**: Automate tasks using AI agents with natural language instructions
- **Multi-Agent Collaboration**: Design systems where multiple agents work together to achieve goals
- **Extensible Architecture**: Easy to add custom agents, tools, and integrations
- **Open Source**: Free to use, modify, and distribute under the Apache 2.0 license

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites

- [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) (v16 or higher)
- [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/)

### Installation

1. Clone the repository:
   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/wayang-ai/wayang.github.io.git
   cd wayang.github.io
   ```

2. Install dependencies:
   ```bash
   npm install
   ```

3. Start the development server:
   ```bash
   npm run dev
   ```

4. Open the application in your browser:
   - [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000)

## Usage

### Building for Production

```bash
npm run build
```

### Running Tests

```bash
npm test
```
